title: The First Carve
premise: A whale lies dead across the channel with a wound cut in its flank. Everything worth having is inward and upstream, and the way back out is the same way.
sessionZero: Nothing carried out is worth anything unless it passed a Tally Post.
The Gut Stone is Deadly and will be announced as such.

clocks.says: The whale is digesting itself. The value clock.
The Render Charge is on a schedule. The law clock.
clocks.note: At 5 the Render Charge fires (Gut Stone hazard).

clocks.says: Everything in the Reach can smell a wound. The danger clock.

clockTriggers.gap: The coded Vector names HUNGER for a body cut and for a body left, without the sign. Proposed +1 for each, once per site for "left".
The sign is not in the coded data. Proposed -1: a kept promise buys time with the law.
"TOLL +1 if the Guild sees it": the barge crew are Guild-licensed and present, so proposed always, unless the crew have been sent away.

directorClockAllowance: one segment per Clock per session (Vector 3.4)

sites.name: The Toll-Vent
sites.readAloud: A torn flank panel the size of a town square, the channel's current running through it. Folded out of the whale's own gristle is a customs post: a chitin gate, a queue of drones, a toll board priced in Specimens. Beyond the gate a cut-lane runs down into the carcass.

zones.name: The wound lip
zones.note: the torn edge you must cross; the gas pocket is under it

exits.name: the cut-lane down
exits.note: way-open is set by toll-settled, by crossing, or when the Sentinel is destroyed

exits.name: back out to the Toll Reach

creatures.note: It does not start the fight. If the Cohort has paid or sworn it stands aside even after a strike.

npcs.name: the customs drones
npcs.wants: the toll, in any printed form
says: the three prices on the board

interactables.name: Taste the water from the wound
Swear a promise at the witness-seam
interactables.needs: a free Oath box; the promise in the player's words; owed to Order II
interactables.gap: The Core Rite takes an hour and 10 S; here the promise is taken on the spot. Proposed: a quick oath is allowed at a printed witness-seam, costs the Oath box only, and the answer to "what do you promise?" is filed at once.

interactables.name: Give the swarms water
interactables.needs: clean water: one Vial of any kind emptied, or 1 S of foam
interactables.gap: The Vector says a swarm offered water leaves but not where the water comes from. Proposed cost as shown.

sites.nothingElse: The drones sell nothing and there is no other way through the flank here.

hazards.name: Gas pocket under the lip
counter: Brace reaction: no damage halved twice, and 2 free Drifts

awards.on: arrive:soft-field with flag:toll-settled and fold-sentinel not destroyed

secrets.text: Bare patches of old biomass on the wound lip.
The floor is humming: something light is welling up under the lip.
The drone fold faces the wrong way: its gate points inward.

sites.name: The Soft Field
sites.readAloud: Hanging sheets of lipid, cut lanes sweet with Guild claim-line, tally-sleds empty on their cable. At the centre stands the Tally Post, where a cut is weighed, graded and stamped. The tools are stacked and unblooded.

zones.name: The near panels
zones.note: the Medusa nest is in one of them

creatures.note: Defending a nest. A Cohort that takes the far panels gets the same harvest with less blood.

creatures.gap: "Add 2 more Mites once the Cohort has got Lesson 4." Proposed test: the Render Hall has been visited.

npcs.name: the Tally Post clerk
npcs.wants: a cut it can stamp under some claim

offers.price: one row of the d12 table, rolled once

says: the ledger's last entry: CLAIM VOID - SEE NETH
unstamped, the cut is worth nothing outside

pricedChoice.roll: d12, once, when the Cohort first reaches the post

rows.offer: stamp under the first crew's void claim
rows.price: the Ash call it grave-robbing; the Guild will not notice for two Beats

rows.offer: stamp under Tallow Ring's second sale
rows.price: free; the first buyer's crew will come to collect

rows.offer: an Ash Unwasted seal on the panel being cut
rows.price: the cut is slower: that panel does not rewind CARCASS
rows.gap: "CARCASS -1 for that panel only" is unclear. Proposed: the panel-opens trigger is skipped for that cut.

rows.offer: a drone licence: Order II stamps it
rows.price: the drones consider you registered, including for what the brood needs

rows.offer: no stamp: the clerk is a client of Neth
rows.price: a Signal Discourse roll at Standard, or 10 to 30 S in samples, fixes it
rows.gap: The contest is not specified. Proposed: AFF + Signal Discourse at Standard, or pay 20 S.

rows.offer: a stamp now for a favour at the Gut Stone
rows.price: the favour arrives at the Gut Stone

rows.offer: the post is empty, the scale still warm

interactables.name: Scout the far panels
interactables.gap: No Threshold is printed. Proposed Common.

interactables.name: Cut a hanging panel
interactables.needs: far panels, or the nest dealt with

interactables.name: Have the cut weighed and stamped
interactables.needs: unstamped Specimens and any claim flag

interactables.name: Cut a panel loose to cloud the lane
interactables.needs: a Kinetic hit with 4+ Overflow on a panel

interactables.name: Take the first crew's salt cache
onSuccess: note: salt spent rewinds CARCASS by 1
interactables.gap: Where the cache is and how it is found is not in the coded data. Proposed: revealed by scout-far.

sites.nothingElse: The stacked tools are ordinary and the sleds are empty; nothing else here can be worked.

hazards.name: Slough patches
hazards.discovery: seen once CARCASS is 1 or more
hazards.note: Below CARCASS 3 it only slows: -1 Drift per move, and soak 1 for a body standing in it.

site.yield: C1 to each organism in the picking order per panel; grade by CARCASS
site.gap: The grade-by-CARCASS table is in Vector 7.2 and was not in the coded data. The yield shown is what the benches paid.

secrets.text: A tally-sled loaded with nothing but tools.
A sweet current coming up from deeper in.
A drone escort moving into the whale, not out.
A stamped cut is 40 to 120 S, only if the claim stands.

sites.lesson: The harvest. This is the Ledger's room.

sites.name: The Render Hall
sites.readAloud: The stomach is still warm and still churning; the fluid pulls at you. A Hegemony pump barge and its crew of nine run a hose near the entrance. Dry ribs line the wall. At the bottom lies the still, hot and quiet.

modifiers.gap: Printed as "-1 to -2 unless prepared". Proposed: -1; -2 for a body in the churn; a Neutraliser or an Osmotic Filter counts as prepared.

zones.name: The pump
zones.note: the barge and its hose; loud

zones.name: The churn
zones.note: drags a body 1 band per Cycle unless it wins Fluid Navigation at Standard

zones.name: The dry ribs
zones.note: walkable along the wall, out of the field and the churn

zones.name: The still
zones.note: at the bottom; the first crew's four bodies

creatures.note: They want the warm fluid and the plasma in it.
At the still, on the first crew. In a fight they Render the four bodies, one each per turn.

npcs.name: the Hegemony pump crew (nine)
says: they are Guild-licensed and will see who touched it

npcs.name: Pump-Hand Osk
npcs.scripted: Taken by the churn on the Cycle after loud:render-hall: he goes Dormant with a Countdown running.
says: once stabilised: where the Gut Stone lies

interactables.name: Taste the haze on the mid floor
Go along the dry ribs
interactables.note: No roll. Avoids the field and the churn.

interactables.name: Seize or open the pump
interactables.pool: RTC + Synthesis, or VSC + Vigour to seize it
onFailure: the crew turn hostile to the attempt
interactables.gap: No pool or Threshold is printed, nor a number for "both Orders lose their footing". Proposed as shown.

interactables.name: Read the first crew's bodies
interactables.needs: at the still; a body not yet Rendered
interactables.gap: Printed as "worth a read, not a haul" with no roll. Proposed as shown. Benches: the Feeders Rendered all four before anyone read them.

sites.nothingElse: Only the pump can be worked here; the ribs, the hose and the barge do nothing else.

secrets.text: Everything in the stomach is scoured clean except one warm, swollen plug.
The haze has a sheen: it strips membrane.
From the still you can see where the plug lies: the far curve of the gut.

sites.lesson: The Pulse War: terrain is the main character.

sites.name: The Brood of the Not-Whale
sites.readAloud: A chamber that should not exist in a dead animal: warm, lit and sweet. Three hundred blind juveniles, whale-shaped but wrong, circle a warm shard of slag. At the gate a grey drone elder has set up a customs post, with forms.

npcs.name: Nine-Folds, the drone elder
npcs.wants: the brood registered: a witness, a signature, and a body that can hold paper

offers.gives: a Name, the Choir's goodwill and a G Specimen
offers.price: the Cohort signs the claim of what the not-whale is

says: what the brood is worth cut: 400 to 900 S, and what it costs

interactables.name: Register the brood
interactables.needs: flag:knows-brood or Nine-Folds' telling; one organism signs

interactables.name: Cut the brood
interactables.gap: "400 to 900 S" has no rule for the amount. Proposed: 400 plus 100 per point of Overflow, capped at 900.

sites.nothingElse: The shard is only warm; the forms mean nothing unless signed.

secrets.text: The juveniles have six fins where a Drifter has four.
The room feels like being asked questions.
The brood's chemistry matches the slag, not the whale: the whale was herding it.

danger.note: Only if the brood is startled.

sites.name: The Gut Stone
sites.readAloud: A plug of fused slag, gut-crud and salt, thirty Drifts across, wedged in the curve of the gut. It is warm. A field of shards drifts before it and an acid halo clings to its face. One shaft leads up.

zones.name: The shard field
zones.gap: "Difficult ground; everything cuts" has no numbers. Proposed: Drifting through costs 1 extra Pulse Point; no damage.

zones.name: The exit shaft
zones.note: up to the Render Hall's pump

exits.name: the exit shaft
exits.note: during the chase this is the finish line

creatures.note: It wants the canister intact. Neither claimant is evil.

creatures.gap: The play note names a Lattice Guardian folded around the print job, but it is not in the encounter list or the 12 BSP. Proposed: it wakes only if the canister is taken, and is not counted in the rating.

npcs.name: the Protease Warden's recovery team

offers.gives: 200 + 50 x Overflow S, to 400, on delivery
offers.price: carry the serial into a Hegemony office and say it aloud

says: a price, once the serial is said aloud

interactables.name: Taste the halo and find the serial
Say the serial aloud to the Warden
Mask the Cohort and slip to the stone face
interactables.gap: No Threshold printed. Proposed Severe (the Warden reads the room for a living); failure Marks the Cohort.

interactables.name: Convince the Guardian the job is complete
interactables.gap: No procedure printed. Proposed: the same three-exchange procedure as the brood.

sites.nothingElse: The stone itself cannot be cut: slag, salt and acid.

hazards.name: The Render Charge
hazards.discovery: the TOLL Clock; players see it

secrets.text: The stone is warm, and something inside it leaks.
Two things claim this room: an armoured recovery team, and something folded still inside the stone.
The canister's serial is in a format retired before your lineage was written.

steps: The Pulse War ends. Creatures not at the stone face stand down; the Warden leaves with the flow.
Each Cycle every organism that is Up rolls DFF + Fluid Navigation at Standard. A carrier of a Dormant body rolls 1 die fewer.
Success: move one band toward the exit shaft. Failure: stay.
An organism at the shaft is out. After 3 Cycles the curve closes: anyone not out is lost with the carcass.
setPieces.gap: The Vector says only "Not survived: raced", and the Core chase is three lines. Benches improvised it and asked a Dormant organism for a throw. Proposed procedure as shown; the 3-Cycle limit is mine.

steps: The Director states what success buys before any roll.
Three exchanges. In each, one organism speaks and rolls AFF + Signal Discourse at Standard.
Two successes: the claim is signed. Fewer: the offer stands but its price rises one step.
setPieces.lose: no change; may be tried once more at a cost
setPieces.gap: The Vector says "three exchanges, Stakes Ladder visible" with no roll. Proposed as shown.

the race is lost, or every organism is Dormant when the Render Charge fires
endings.says: The carcass ends with you in it.
The whale goes over; nothing left in it is worth cutting.
endings.gap: What "the whale goes over" does to a Cohort still inside is not in the coded data.

endings.says: The Render Cascade: everything in the Reach arrives at once.
endings.gap: No procedure in the coded data.

briefings.toll-vent:
SITE: The Toll-Vent. A torn flank panel the size of a town square, the channel's current running through it. Folded out of the whale's own gristle is a customs post: a chitin gate, a queue of drones, a toll board priced in Specimens. Beyond the gate a cut-lane runs down into the carcass.
HERE: 1 Fold Sentinel (guarding; looks: broad, braced and unmarked); 2 Gnaw Swarm (indifferent; looks: a tight, seething coat of soft segments).
WHO: the customs drones wants the toll, in any printed form.
CAN BE DONE: Taste the water from the wound; Pay the toll in Specimens; Pay the toll in Substrate; Swear a promise at the witness-seam; Shoulder through the gate; Give the swarms water; Vent the gas pocket slowly. The drones sell nothing and there is no other way through the flank here.
WAYS OUT: the cut-lane down; back out to the Toll Reach.
SEEN ON ARRIVAL: Bare patches of old biomass on the wound lip.
TEACHES: The roll.
briefings.soft-field:
SITE: The Soft Field. Hanging sheets of lipid, cut lanes sweet with Guild claim-line, tally-sleds empty on their cable. At the centre stands the Tally Post, where a cut is weighed, graded and stamped. The tools are stacked and unblooded.
HERE: 2 Glaze Medusa (guarding; looks: clear as the water, trailing long lines).
WHO: the Tally Post clerk wants a cut it can stamp under some claim.
CAN BE DONE: Read the post's ledger; Scout the far panels; Cut a hanging panel; Have the cut weighed and stamped; Cut a panel loose to cloud the lane; Salt a slough patch; Take the first crew's salt cache. The stacked tools are ordinary and the sleds are empty; nothing else here can be worked.
WAYS OUT: the cut-lane to the stomach; the sled-cable to the surface; back up the cut-lane.
SEEN ON ARRIVAL: A tally-sled loaded with nothing but tools.
TEACHES: The harvest. This is the Ledger's room.
briefings.render-hall:
SITE: The Render Hall. The stomach is still warm and still churning; the fluid pulls at you. A Hegemony pump barge and its crew of nine run a hose near the entrance. Dry ribs line the wall. At the bottom lies the still, hot and quiet.
HERE: 3 Cytoplasmic Bleeder (hunting; looks: long, soft and whole); 2 Detritus Feeder (indifferent; looks: fat and busy).
WHO: the Hegemony pump crew (nine) wants to finish the shift; Pump-Hand Osk wants not to die.
CAN BE DONE: Taste the haze on the mid floor; Go along the dry ribs; Seize or open the pump; Read the first crew's bodies; Stabilise Osk. Only the pump can be worked here; the ribs, the hose and the barge do nothing else.
WAYS OUT: the pyloric channels, up; the pump shaft; back down the cut-lane.
SEEN ON ARRIVAL: Everything in the stomach is scoured clean except one warm, swollen plug.
TEACHES: The Pulse War: terrain is the main character.
briefings.brood:
SITE: The Brood of the Not-Whale. A chamber that should not exist in a dead animal: warm, lit and sweet. Three hundred blind juveniles, whale-shaped but wrong, circle a warm shard of slag. At the gate a grey drone elder has set up a customs post, with forms.
HERE: no creatures in sight.
WHO: Nine-Folds, the drone elder wants the brood registered: a witness, a signature, and a body that can hold paper.
CAN BE DONE: Smell what the brood is; Register the brood; Cut the brood. The shard is only warm; the forms mean nothing unless signed.
WAYS OUT: the pyloric duct; back the way you came.
SEEN ON ARRIVAL: The juveniles have six fins where a Drifter has four.
TEACHES: The law and the ledger.
briefings.gut-stone:
SITE: The Gut Stone. A plug of fused slag, gut-crud and salt, thirty Drifts across, wedged in the curve of the gut. It is warm. A field of shards drifts before it and an acid halo clings to its face. One shaft leads up.
HERE: 1 Protease Warden (will-talk; looks: pale kit unmarked, register arm raised); 2 Cytoplasmic Bleeder (guarding; looks: long, soft and whole); 4 Antigen Gnat (guarding; looks: a loose cloud of rust-bright motes).
WHO: the Protease Warden's recovery team wants the canister intact.
CAN BE DONE: Taste the halo and find the serial; Say the serial aloud to the Warden; Agree to carry the serial; Mask the Cohort and slip to the stone face; Convince the Guardian the job is complete. The stone itself cannot be cut: slag, salt and acid.
WAYS OUT: the exit shaft; the pyloric duct.
SEEN ON ARRIVAL: The stone is warm, and something inside it leaks.
SAY FIRST: "This is Deadly."
TEACHES: The ending.
